project.title: KODE Immersive - Tech-Enabled Creativity, Unforgettable Experiences.
project.format: Nuxt-based immersive agency homepage with canvas scenes and guided interaction

why: A strong reference for blending cinematic staging with explicit interaction prompts: the site treats the preloader, scratch reveal, step-based services section, and sound controls as one continuous narrative system instead of separate gimmicks.

compositions.title: Enter-gated preloader scene
compositions.study: The first frame is a branded preloader with a hidden counter, lottie animation, and an explicit Enter action instead of an automatic handoff.
compositions.reuse: Use when a story-led site should give visitors a moment to opt into the experience instead of dropping them straight into the main scroll.

compositions.title: Alternating text and canvas chapters
compositions.study: The page alternates oversized justified text panels, fixed bottom-bar cues, canvas-backed scenes, and narrative copy blocks to keep the scroll rhythm varied.
compositions.reuse: Use when immersive storytelling needs strong pacing changes between copy-heavy beats and visual interaction beats.

compositions.title: Full-viewport canvas shell
compositions.study: Canvas layers for the background, mouse trails, chevrons, noise, and hero moments stay mounted around the content instead of appearing as one isolated hero widget.
compositions.reuse: Keep the stage infrastructure persistent when motion cues should connect the whole page rather than one section.

assets.notes: The homepage reserves multiple canvases for the preloader, background, chevron, noise, and scratch interactions.
assets.reuse: Plan canvas ownership at the page shell level when multiple chapters depend on the same motion runtime.

assets.role: voice contrast between operational copy and expressive display
assets.notes: Aeonik Pro and OT Brut separate practical labels from oversized theatrical headlines.
assets.reuse: Use a two-role type system when interaction prompts need to feel exact but the headline voice still needs drama.

assets.role: preloader, bottom bars, and contact overlay controls
assets.notes: The site treats entry, scroll cues, sound toggles, and contact information as styled overlays rather than generic utility chrome.
assets.reuse: Make utility states part of the same visual world as the immersive content.

motion.title: Manual entry into the experience
motion.notes: A lottie-led preloader and Enter button pace the first transition into the scroll instead of starting automatically.
motion.fallback: Reduced-motion handling was not verified; keep the entry gate optional and preserve direct access to the main content when reusing the pattern.

motion.title: Persistent scroll cue choreography
motion.notes: Fixed bottom bars repeatedly restate Scroll for more so the story keeps a guided tempo even as the visual treatment flips between white and black modes.
motion.fallback: Scroll cues should not be the only instruction path on touch or keyboard-driven browsing.

motion.title: Canvas-backed micro-scenes
motion.notes: The site layers moving canvas scenes and animated text transitions across several sections rather than concentrating all movement in the hero.
motion.fallback: Provide still or low-motion equivalents for every chapter so the narrative can survive without animated canvas effects.

interactions.title: Scratch around logo reveal
interactions.study: A dedicated Scratch around prompt turns the logo canvas into an exploratory reveal instead of a passive brand mark.
interactions.reuse: Use when a reveal should feel playful and discoverable, but keep the hidden state non-essential.

interactions.title: Prev/Next service navigator
interactions.study: The services section behaves like a numbered scene stepper with Prev and Next controls instead of a static accordion or grid.
interactions.reuse: Use for sequential service storytelling when each step needs its own canvas or animated state.

interactions.title: Overlay-level sound control
interactions.study: The contact overlay includes a bracketed Sound On/Off control so audio state is treated as a first-class part of the experience.
interactions.reuse: Expose sound state explicitly whenever audio contributes to the brand experience.

implementation.format: Nuxt-rendered immersive scroll site with persistent canvases, overlay UI, and step-based chapter controls
implementation.notes: Static inspection confirmed an Enter preloader, fixed scroll bars, scratch canvas, service stepper, sound toggle, and multiple always-mounted canvas layers, which is enough to preserve it as an accepted motion reference.
